question: Who was awarded the ICC Men’s Player of the Month for November 2025 after a match-winning Test series performance against India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simon Harmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **South Africa’s off-spinner Simon Harmer was named ICC Men’s Player of the Month for November 2025 for his dominant performances against India in the World Test Championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Simon Harmer claimed 17 wickets** in a two-Test series against India, emerging as the decisive factor.
 
• **His performance guided South Africa to a 2–0 Test series victory in India**, their first such series win on Indian soil since 2000.
 
• **Harmer was also adjudged Player of the Series** for his consistent match-winning spells.
 
• **He won the ICC monthly award ahead of Taijul Islam (Bangladesh) and Mohammad Nawaz (Pakistan).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **The ICC Men’s Player of the Month award** recognises outstanding individual performances across all international formats.
 
• **The ICC World Test Championship (WTC)** is a league-based Test competition that determines the world’s top Test-playing nation.
 
• **Off-spin bowling** relies on finger rotation to generate turn, playing a crucial role on subcontinental pitches.
 
• **South Africa’s series win in India** is considered historic due to India’s long-standing dominance at home in Test cricket.
